descriptions.w3d_s20_set_low_bit_801865c0: Appears to set the lowest flag bit and notify through virtual method 39, returning zero when the bit already had the requested value.
descriptions.w3d_s20_set_matrix_80186614: Appears to copy a 48-byte matrix into the object at offset 56 and return zero.
descriptions.w3d_s20_set_vectors_8018993c: Appears to copy two three-float vectors into the inner object at offsets 120 and 108 and return zero.
descriptions.w3d_s20_find_record_8019a2a8: Appears to search two vectors of 24-byte records for a 16-bit key at offset 18 and return the record or null.
descriptions.w3d_s20_count_active_entries_8018a800: Appears to count, per slot index, the global entries of 276 bytes whose flag word has any bit above bit 0 set.
